name: Fitness Autopilot
install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && ([ -f apps/mobile/.env ] || cp apps/mobile/.env.example apps/mobile/.env)

terminals.name: expo-web
terminals.description: Expo (React Native Web) dev server for the mobile app in local-planner mode. Serves the UI at http://127.0.0.1:19006 with the deterministic domain engines running in-process (no Supabase required).
